name: Weavs
summary:
# Weavs

Weavs is a VR game built around chaotic minigames and a tense build-and-survive horror mode you can play with friends.


# Horror Mode

The horror mode you and your friends prepare during the day and fight to survive at night.

During the day, you build and upgrade your base, place defenses, gather what you need. When night falls, monsters come out and attack from different directions, forcing your team to defend what you built. Every monster changes how you need to build your base.
